title: DatedFact
description: Something an app says will happen at a time — a meeting, a deadline, an absence, a task, a milestone, an agent's run — so that the center's Planifier shows the time of the whole organization (doctrine D-050). Sent again under the same key, it replaces what was said; sent with `cancelled`, it is taken back. Exactly one of `day` (a whole day) or `starts_at` (a moment) is given.

key.description: The app's own key for this fact: one fact per app and key.

kind.description: meeting: people meet. deadline: something is due (an invoice, a report, a contract's term). absence: a person is away. task: a piece of work with its duration. milestone: a step of a project. agent_run: an agent or a routine will run.

label.description: What it is, as a person reads it: « Échéance F-2026-0003 », « Réception du matériel ».

day.description: A whole day. With `until`, the last day of a span (a leave from the 2nd to the 6th).

until.description: The last day of a span that started on `day`.

ends_at.description: When a fact with a moment ends; none for an instant.

person_ids.description: The people of the center it concerns: who meets, who is away, who must do it.

visibility.description: shared (the default): its label is read by whoever may read its project or its people. busy: others see only that the person is taken. private: only the people it concerns see it. An absence is always read without its reason.

href.description: Where it is read, in the app.
